report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all checkout traces and logs show HTTP 200 with request_result ok, and metrics show 8 successful /v1/checkout 200 responses with zero 502s. The only deployment record is a baseline v1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No evidence of checkout errors exists; hand off for human review rather than assert a bounded cause.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing actual checkout errors (non-2xx responses, error logs, or error spans) to confirm the incident exists
Deployment history beyond the single baseline v1.0.0 record to test the faulty-deployment hypothesis
Error-rate or failure metrics for checkout across versions to compare pre/post deployment
